source_region.A2.SS2.SSS2.p3: For \lambda\geq 0, let h_{\lambda}(x):=e^{-\lambda\|x\|^{2}} and define H(\lambda):=\mathbb{E}\left[\det(O)\int_{\mathbb{R}^{n}}h_{\lambda}(x)p_{O}(x)\,dx\right]. Since the two determinant components have Haar probability 1/2, H(\lambda)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathbb{E}_{P_{+1}}h_{\lambda}-\mathbb{E}_{P_{-1}}h_{\lambda}\right). As 0<h_{\lambda}\leq 1, it follows that \operatorname{TV}(P_{+1},P_{-1})\geq 2|H(\lambda)|. (20) We compute H(\lambda) and then choose \lambda>0.
